title: Something About Us
lyrics:
[01:17.43]It might not be the right time
[01:22.17]I might not be the right one
[01:26.12]But there's something about us, I want to say
[01:30.82]'Cause there's something between us anyway
[01:36.56]I might not be the right one
[01:41.45]It might not be the right time
[01:45.32]But there's something about us I've got to do
[01:50.88]Some kind of secret I will share with you
[01:55.76]I need you more than anything in my life
[02:00.64]I want you more than anything in my life
[02:05.44]I'll miss you more than anyone in my life
[02:10.25]I love you more than anyone in my life
